title: Shiv Ganga
desc: A tale of love and lust, Shiv Ganga narrates how the god of love Kamdev met and subsequently lost his consort Rati, the goddess of passion.

title: Bhala Manus
desc: Shankar a simple villager comes to Bombay in such of work to improve his financial condition but circumstances force him to take up smuggling.

title: Kohram
desc: Major Ajit is assigned to expose Major Sodhi, the man who attempted to kill the Home Minister and is now hiding under a guise. Major Ajit sets out on his mission, but when he learns Sodhi's reasons for doing what he did, Ajit joins hands with him.

title: Tum Haseen Main Jawan
desc: A navy officer who has had a number of affairs with attractive young women meets a beautiful girl and falls in love. Though she loves him in return, another admirer of hers tells the officer that she is deceiving him and is the mother of a child.
